    AI Overview
    Vote for American Idol 2026 via three methods: online at
    AmericanIdol.com/Vote, by texting the contestant's number to 21523, or via official Instagram and TikTok pinned posts. You can cast up to 10 votes per contestant, per method, for a total of 30+ votes, usually starting at 7 PM CT. 
    Key Voting Information: 
    • Website: Visit americanidol.com/vote to create an account and vote.
    • Text: Text the designated number (e.g., "9") to 21523 to vote for a contestant.
    • Social Media: Comment the contestant's name on the pinned "Official Vote Post" on Instagram and Facebook.
    • Eligibility: Must be 16+ and located in the U.S., Puerto Rico, or the Virgin Islands.
    • Timing: Voting is generally open during live episodes, usually starting around 7 PM CT.

    How to vote for American Idol tonight?
    An AI Overview is not available for this searchCan't generate an AI overview right now. Try again later.
    AI Overview
    You can vote on American Idol tonight during the live show (typically 8 p.m. ET/5 p.m. PT) through three main methods: online at
    AmericanIdol.com/Vote, on the American Idol app, or via SMS text. Voting usually allows up to 10 votes per contestant per method. 
    How to Vote Tonight: 
    • Online/App: Visit AmericanIdol.com/vote or download the American Idol app on iOS or Android. You will need to create or sign in with an ABC account.
    • Text: Text the contestant's number to 21523.
    • Social Media: Look for the "Official Vote Post" on the @AmericanIdol Instagram, Facebook, or TikTok accounts. Comment the name of your favorite contestant to vote. 
    Important Information: 
    • Eligibility: You must be 16 or older and located in the U.S., Puerto Rico, or the Virgin Islands to vote on the website/app.
    • Limits: Typically, you get 10 votes per contestant, per voting method (e.g., 10 for website, 10 for app, 10 for text, etc.).
    • Timing: Voting is generally open during the live broadcast, usually closing shortly after the show airs (e.g., 6 a.m. EST the following morning). 
    Note: Message and data rates may apply for text voting.
